paragraphs: Bitco Software sells PermitTrax, hosted software for governments and agencies. It follows a permit from application through to final inspection.

Building permits are accepted and issued online, with mobile inspections carried out in the field. A planning module circulates applications, keeps up communication with applicants, and issues land use permits. A licensing module renews and issues business licenses and takes payments online or over the counter. Code enforcement staff track complaint cases, run in-field inspections, and issue violation letters and notices. A public portal called Citizens Connect lets residents track permit progress, request inspections, upload files, apply for permits, and pay online. Inspectors work from a companion application on an Apple iPad.

The company was established in December 2002. Cory Jorgensen is listed as founder and president. The suite is now described as a land management system covering permit, license, and code case tracking, reporting, GIS integration, and electronic plan review. Pricing is a flat fee for the license and maintenance. That fee is said to cover implementation, data conversion, training, and unlimited users.

quote.text: Bitco Software is dedicated to delivering simplicity, automation, and efficiency.
